spacing.rule: Generous spacing around gaming interactive elements to prevent accidental touches. Dense utility layout for data screens like leaderboards. Use md (12) and lg (16) for inner padding of cards.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design specifically for the 'Dark-First Utility DARK' personality but with flashy gaming elements and glowing accents. The vibe is a midnight Tunisian café mixed with an e-sports interface.
The colors are strictly deep espresso/obsidian (surface), electric mint (brandPrimary), and lantern copper (brandSecondary). Avoid blue/purple entirely.
Game Table: ensure an octagonal or stylized rounded layout for the players on the screen, optimizing elbow room and tap targets.
Animations: the 'deal animation' and 'trick-collection' should use react-native-reanimated. Bidding panel should slide up smoothly using bottom_sheet.
For the background in Auth or Home, overlay the splash_background image with a 3-stop vertical gradient scrim (transparent to solid surface) so text on top is 100% readable.
When updating the frontend files, overwrite the existing colors/fonts in '/app/frontend/src/theme.ts' with these new exact hex values.
Ensure RTL handling is possible for Tunisian Arabic option in the UI components, keeping layout responsive.
